tei:div.tei:p: zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi gsol 'debs byin brlabs rol mtsho'o/ /

na ma mañdzu shṝ ye/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dpal sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i sngon 'gro'i yan lag gsol 'debs byin brlabs rol mtsho zhes bya ba| bla ma dam pa byin brlabs kyi chu 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la dad cing gus pa yis/ /rtse gcig gdung bas gsol btab na/ /phun tshogs mtha' dag dgegs med par/ /stsol mdzad bla ma mchog la 'dud/ /gang dag 'phral dang yun gyi phan bde don du gnyer ba des/ dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa gtan mi byed pa'am/ byed kyang zhor chos su byas nas thabs gzhan la 'bad pa 'don pa de dag ni/ chu don du gnyer bas/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi mtsho 'gram du ba tshwa'i khron pa nan gyis rko ba'am/ nor don du gnyer bas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po la gsol ba gdab tu yod bzhin du dor nas bur shing btsong pa'i rin gyis nor sgrub pa la 'bad rtsol cher byed pa dang 'dra'o/ /des na bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa ni lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang*/ srog shing dang*/ bogs 'don gegs sel te/ blo sbyong las/ rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya/ /zhes pa ltar bya rgyu'i gtso bo bla na med par shes par bya'o/ /de yang dbang ma thob pa mang po dang lhan cig mkhod pa'i tshe/ mdo phyogs kyi rtsa rgyud bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ rgyud sdai 'og ma'i dbang tsam thob pas kyang*/ bya spyod dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gsol 'debs kho bos byas pa lta bus gsol ba gdab cing*| chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i gang drin ma dang sku spyod ma lta bu bla med kyi gsol 'debs khyad par can rnams ni de'i dbang ma thob pas thos par yang byar mi rung na de nyid kyis mi rung ba lta ci smos te/ chos la zab khyad ma byas na byin brlabs mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ khyad par bla med kyi zab 'khrid khyad par can la rten pa'i gsol 'debs dang smon lam la sogs pa bsod snyoms byed pa'i zhing khar byed pa lta bu ni/

mkha' 'gro'i bar chad nan gyis sgrub pa'o/ des na zab don khyad par can gyi sgo nas bla ma la bstod pa dang rang nyid smon lam du byed pa'i mtshan nyid rnams ni/ 'khrid yig khyad par can dang 'dra bar dbang ma thob pa la sba bar bya ba yin no/ /de ltar na 'dir yang gang drin ma la sogs pa yang spro zhing nus na bya la/ khyad par bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i/ dpe med 'tsho'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ dpal ldan sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang*/ /don gnyis mthar phyin khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po mngon gyur nas/ /skye med gzhan don nus par byin gyis brlob/ /rdo rje 'chang las de nyid gdams pa thob| |grub chen dpe med 'tsho la zung 'jug sogs/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi rjes 'brang tshong dpon sras/ /grub thob dpal 'dzin zhabs la= /bla mas rjes bzung gsang sngags rig 'dzin thob/ /paṇa chen 'od byed lha= shes bya kun la mkhas par grags pa bsnyed/ /chos 'byung zhi ba'i zhabs= ngag dbang grub pa'i gsang sngags nges don mkhas/ /grub thob nyi ma dpal= btson pas sgrub pas bde mchog grub pa bsnyes/ /paṇa chen rin po mtsho= /bde mchog zhal gzigs sha ba ris rjes bzung*/ /pan chen bi bhū ti= gsang sngags gnad rig dus gsum mkhyen pa sogs/ /grub chen ko brag pa= rtog pas rang grol brtse bas sems can skyong*/ /rgyas sras gzhon nu dpal= dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo chos kyi rje/ /mkhan chen nyi ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zung 'jug sogs re re la sbyor/ zab lam nyams myong ston mkhas yon tan rgyas/ /chos rje bu staun= bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug lam la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /mkhas grub chos kyi dpal la= snga ma 'di dang phyi ma chos rje bsod nams 'phel bas mdzad/ mkhas mchog rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar son pa/ /rin chen bsod 'phel ba la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sbyar bar bya'o/ /yang zhwa lu ba'i gsung rgyun byin brlabs can du byed pa'i gnas bzhugs ma ni/

dpal ldan 'bras dpung gi mchod rten du/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam rgyud la skyes bar byin gyis brlobs/ /bde stong zung 'jug rdzogs par byin gyis brlabs| |rkang pa 'di gnyis kun la sbyar/ byang sham+bha la'i pho brang du/ /chos rgyal sum cu so gnyis la= byang sham+bha la'i lam bar du/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs sprul pa= shar e de bi sha'i grong khyer du/ /grub thob tse lu paṇa chen la= byang sham bha la'i grong khyer du/ /paṇ+ḍi ātsar+yā la= byang tso ra ya sha'i grong khyair du// dpal dus zhabs pa chen po= shar me tog khyim gyi pho brang du/ /rje dus zhabs pa chung pa= dpal na len+d+ra'i gzhal yas su/ /paṇa chen mañdzu kirti la= /bal yul ye rangs kyi grong khyer du/ /dpal sa man+ṭa shṝ= nub mda' rdo can gyi dgon pa ru| |rwa lo tsā ba chos rab la= ne'u me tog ldan gyi dgon pa ru/ /rā ye shes seng ge la= khyu lung se spyi'i dgon pa ru/ /rwa 'bum seng chen po la= dben dmar dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /rje btsun rga lo chen po la= dmu lha sham+bhar gyi dgon pa ru/ /bla ma shes rab seng ge la= gnas chen pho ma ltag ri ru/ /bla ma dpal ldan seng ge la= dben dmar sham bar gyi dgon pa ru/ /bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan= nges med chos 'phel gyi dgon pa ru/ /'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho= zha lu ri sbug gi dben gnas su/ /chos rje bu ston lo tsā= 'og min bde chen gyi dgon pa ru/ /mkhas grub chos kyi dpal la= go lung dben rtsa'i sgrub gnas su/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces pa rwa brgyud dang*| 'bro brgyud la'ang*/ tshigs bcad dang po gnyis 'dra/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha' drung du/ /rigs ldan rgyal po dpal skyong = de rjes dus zhabs che chung gnyis 'dra/ kha che khṛ brtan gyi pho brang du/ /paṇa chen zla ba mgon po la= rgya bod gnyis kyi sa cha ru/ /'bro ston lo tsā chen po la=/

'phan yul grab kyi yang dben du/ /dgon pa dkon mchog bsrungs= 'phan yul snor bzangs kyi dgon pa ru/ /sgro ston gnam la brtsaigs= 'u yug rgya khab kyi pho brang du/ /yu mo mi skyod rdo rje= g.yas ru drod chung gi dgon pa ru/ /sras dharme shwa ra= khang gsar dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /bla ma nam mkha' 'od zer= man ngag pho lung gi dgon pa ru/ /se mo che nam mkha' rgyal mtshan= nyang stod skyang 'dur gyi dben gnas su| |'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer= dge sdings dpal gyi dgon pa ru// bla ma chos sku 'od zer= nags rgyal bde ldan gyi dgon pa ru/ /kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus la= 'phags 'od man 'dra ba'am/ yang na bu nas dpal ldan sa skya'i dben gnas su/ /chos rje bsod nams rgyan mtshan= gtsang chos 'khor sgang gi dgon pa ru/ /lo chen skyabs mchog mtshan can= gzim khang bde ba can gyi pho brang du/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma= byang sems nam mkha' 'od zer= 'di la rkang pa tha ma gnyis kyi tshab tu/ byin brlabs char ltar 'bab par byin gyis brlobs/ /nyams rtogs me ltar 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes sbyar na'ang rung ste/ mkhas rmongs kun gyis bzung sla zhing byin brlabs myur bar grags so/ /spro zhing nus na/ chos rje lo chen gyis mdzad pa rgyas bsdus 'di gnyis kyang bya ste/ na ma shṝ rat+na gu ru bh+yaḥ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi dpal ldan bla ma rin po che rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa dpal ldan bla ma'i byin brlabs dang dngos grub kyi yon tan thams cad 'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo chos rje bla ma rin po che'i zhabs kyi pad mo dri ma med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'chi'o/ /sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la dus dang rnam pa thams cad du byin gyis brlabs tu gsol lo/

dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo sku bzhi'i bdag/mkhyen pa bzhi ldan byang chub bzhi brnyes pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba bdebs/ /rnam kun mchog ldan sna tshogs gzugs 'chang zhing*// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i skad kyis chos kun ston/ /mtha' gnyis rnam spangs zung 'jug bde ba che/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang la = rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /sgrib bral rna ba'i dbang pos legs gnas pa/ /'gro ba kun skad so sor bsdud mdzad pa'i/ /gsang bdag zla ba bzang = mtshan dang dpe byas bzang pos rab mdzes shing*/ /dbang phyug yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs la| |phun tshogs sa bcu'i rtogs pa rab rgyas pa'i/ /shākya'i rgyal po drug=/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku/ /rigs bzhi rdo rje'i rigs su legs bsdus nas/ /dpal ldan bsdus pa'i rgyud rgyal ston mdzad pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs grags pa'i zhabs= sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi spul pa'i sku/ /dri med 'od kyis phan bde rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /pad ma dkar po'i zhabs= 'gro ba kun la dam pa'i lam ston cing*| |bdud dang kla klo'i chos sogs mthar byed pa/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyas sras khro bo'i sku/ /rigs ldan nyi shu gsum la= sgrol mas lung bstan sham+bha lar byon nas/ /rigs ldan rgyal pos dngos su byin brlabs shing*/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /grub chen dus 'khor zhabs= zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor legs bsgoms pas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub rab brnyes te| |dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /dus zhabs gnyis pa'i zhabs= phyi nang grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ khyad par rgyud sde zab mo'i don rtogs te/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal du legs byon pa'i/ /paṇa chen zla mgon zhabs=

gus pas bla ma'i zhabs pad legs bsten pas/ /gzhung dang gdam pa ma lus yongs rdzogs shing*/ /bsgom pas yon tan rin chen gter kha bye| |sgom pa dkon mchog bsrungs= mtha' bral lta ba'i de nyid legs rtogs nas| |bde stong zung 'jug lam la rab gnas shing*/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i/ /sgro ston gnam la rtsegs= bde gsal phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs nas/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po rab bsgoms pas/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po'i rtogs pa brnyes/ /grub chen yu mo'i zhabs= sngon bsags tshogs gnyis rgya chen shugs goms pas/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos rnams ma lus la/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i ye shes rab rgyas pa/ /chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs= thos pas sde snod zab mo'i don rig cing*/ /bsgoms pas rgyud sde zab mo'i rtogs pa rgyas/ /bshad pas gdul bya zab mo'i lam la sbyor| |nam mkha' 'od zer zhabs= dpag yas ting 'dzin sgo mangs rab phye nas| |ngo mtshar mngon shes rnam 'phrul mtha' yas ston/ /bcu drug skye bas byang chub mchog brnyes pa'i/ /grub thob se mo che la= 'chad rtsod brtsom pas bshad brgyud bstan pa spel/ /lta spyod bsgom pas bsgrub brgyud bstan pa 'dzin| |mkhyen brtse'i nus pas gdul bya'i don kun mdzad/ /'jam dbyangs gsar ma'i zhabs= mdo rgyud man ngag kun la legs goms pas/ /mtha' yas lung rtogs chos kyi gter gyur cing*/ /ma byon sangs rgyas gsum par yongs grags pa'i/ /chos sku 'od zer zhabs= sde snod rgyud sde mang po'i don gzigs nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa lhur mdzad pas/ /rtogs pa'i mchog brnyes sgrub brgyud bstan pa spel/ /kun spangs chen po'i zhabs= gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i tshul la rab sbyangs nas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho lam la rab brtson zhing*| /yon tan rgya mtsho sbas pa'i rnam 'byor pa/ /kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od= dge tshogs rin chen dpag med las grub cing*/

/mkhyen brtse 'phrin las phun tshogs rab rgyas pas/ /rtsod dus thams cad mkhyen par rab grags pa'i// chos rje bu ston zhabs la= dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*/ /srid gsum sems can kun gyi gnyen gcig po/ /sa gsum 'gran dang bral ba chos ky-i rgyal/ /chos rje rin po che= sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma khyed rnams la// rtag tu sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis/ /dus dang rnam pa kun tu byin gyis brlabs/ khams drug ldan zhing tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i lus/ /kun rtog 'pho bas bag chags kun bskrus nas| |lam zab rin chen rgyan gyis legs spras te/ /mi 'gyur dga' bde rgyas par byin gyis rlabs/ /srid gsum srid zhi'i mtsho las sgral bya'i phyir// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi lam gcig po/ /thog mtha' bar gsum dge ba'i rnal 'byor mchog /yid ches gsum ldan bsgom pa= rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i yul rnams la/ /sgrib bral dbang po'i tshogs rnams rab 'jug cing*/ /ma dag 'khrul pa'i las snang kun nub te/ /bzung 'dzin rang sar grol bar= rang gi sems kyi snang ba las byung ba'i/ /nam mkha'i lam gnas stong nyid phyag rgya che| |gzugs med gzugs 'chang rdul bral dri ma med/ /snang stong dbyer med rtogs pa= rmi lam sgyu ma dri za'i grong khyer dang*/ /pra phab snang ba mig 'phrul gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /yon tan rtag chad bral bar legs rtogs nas// phyogs 'dzin kun dang bral bar= shes rab rtog dang spyod dang dga' ba dang*/ g.yo me/ da bde ba chen po nyid thob ste/ /gzugs sems dbyer med gcig tu 'dres gyur nas/ /dag pa'i mngon shes 'char bar= srog rlung nyi zla'i rgyu ba dang bral zhing*/ /rtag tu dbu ma'i nang du legs zhugs nas/ /steng 'og 'khor lo'i lte bar rab bkod de/ /rtag tu g.yo med 'dzin par= gtum mo ye shes snang ba rab rgyal pas/

/'dod pa'i lha mthong gzugs brnyan rnam rtog bral/ /dri med 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ldan pas/ /lus las khams gsum spro bar= 'od gsal phyag rgya che la rjes chags pas/ /mi 'gyur bde ba dbugs kyi grangs 'phel te/ /'khor 'das ro mnyam bden gnyis dbyer med pa'i/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen paur= bden gnyis dbyer med lam la legs goms pas// gnyis su 'dzin pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /e waṃ thabs shes bde stong la sogs pa/ /dbyer med zung 'jug thob par= chos kun gzhi rtsa gnas skabs rnam pa bzhi/ /rnal 'byor bzhi sogs lam gyis legs dag ste/ /sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi dang mkhyen pa bzhi/ /byang chub bzhi sogs thob bar= gzhi la gnas pa'i rigs drug dri ma rnams/ /zab lam yan lag drug gis legs sbyangs te/ khams drug sgrib bral 'bras bu mchog thob nas/ /'gro drug sems can 'dren par= ma dag 'khor ba'i sum cu rtsa drug rigs/ /dag pa'i so drug rigs su gnas gyur te/ /phung khams dbang yul las dbang bya ba gzhan/ /sgrib bral so drug thob par= phung khams skye mched las dbang bya ba rnams/ /sgrib med ro mnyam gcig tu 'dres gyur te/ /bde chen waṃ yig stong chen 'gyur med lnga/ / ye shes lnga ldan thob par= sum cu rtsa drug rigs rnams sgrib bral nas/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i gnas/ /chos kun rten gcig e yig thig le stong*/ /'gyur med rnam drug thob par= rlung me chu sa lhun po pad+ma dang*/ /zla nyi sgra gcan mkha' sogs sgrib bral te/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum kun khyab ye shes mchog |rnam bcu dbang ldan thob par = dus sbyor bcu gnyis rlung gi rgyu ba 'gags| |rten 'brel bcu gnyis phyi nang sgrib pa zad/ /gnas sogs bcu gnyis sa rnams legs bgrod de/ /bden don bcu gnyis ldan par= 'gyur ba dga' ba bcu drug mun pa sangs/ /stod nyid snying rje bcu drug dkyil 'khor rgyas|

|bcu drug sku yi cha shas yongs rdzogs te/ /de nyid bcu drug rig par= nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i grangs kyi ni/ /las rlung 'pho ba'i skad cig gi bcom ste| |myur du bde ba'i cha shas kun rdzogs nas/ /don gnyis phun sum tshogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ces pa 'di sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor pa chen po dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun dga' bsod nams pas bskul nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa shākya'i dge slong*/ skyabs mchog dpal bzang pos drag po'i lo mchu'i zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes gcig la sbyar ba'o/ /'di la brten nas sems can thams cad kyis dpal ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i dbang phyug gi go 'phangs myur du thob par gyur cig 'di'i chos rje bla ma'i 'jug tu/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus a ti shas/ /rgyal ba'i legs gsung 'dul ba'i nyams len sogs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel phyir slar byon pa/ /rgyal ba skyabs mchog zhabs la= de sras thu bo rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang*/ /de sras grub pa'i dbang phyug tshul khrims 'bar/

/dge sbyong mchog gyur sems pa chen po'i mtshan/ /nam mkha' 'od zer zhabs la= tshig bcad 'og ma 'di gnyis mchan du 'dug pa skyus la bris pa lags/ / na mo rat+na gu ru bh+yaḥ dpal sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i dpal ldan bla ma'i yon tan kun 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnams kun mchog ldan stong pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i cha shas rdzogs/ /spangs rtogs mdzad pa'i 'od dkar phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku bzhi'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan shākya'i rgyal po bdun/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rigs ldan nyi shu lnga/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis brlobs/ /tshig rkang 'di kun la sbyar/ rigs ldan rgyal pos byin rlabs dus 'khor zhabs/ /dus 'khor bstan pa rgyas mdzad dus 'khor zhabs/ /gsang chen 'gro ba'i dpal gyur zla ba mgon/ /gzhung dang gdam ngag kun 'dzin dkon mchog bsrungs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis phun tshogs gnam la rtsaigs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub chen yu mo'i zhabs// sprul pa'i skyes mchog dharme shwo ra dang*/ /thos bsam bsgom pas rgyud grol nam mkha' 'od/ /dus gsum rnam mkhyen grub thob se mo che/ /mkhas shing grub pa'-i skyes mchog 'jam dbyangs gsar/ /lung rtogs chos kyi spyan ldan chos sku 'od// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan kun spangs zhabs/ /gsang sngags rgya mcho'i mthar son 'phags pa 'od/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bu ston zhabs// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dngos chos kyi rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /zab yangs shes bya'i mkha' la thogs pa med/ / dmigs med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas/ /lhun grub mdzad pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur spro/ /chos rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/

/kun rtog 'khrul pa'i mun pa ma lus sangs/ /'od gsal dag pa'i snang ba rab 'byams rgyas| |shes dang shes bya'i yul kun gcig tu 'dres/ /chos rje = rlung sems dbu ma'i nang du rab tu brtan/ /bdud dang nyon mongs rgyu ba mtha' dag 'gags| |'byung 'jug 'gro 'ong bral ba'i rtogs pa brnyes/ /chos = 'khor ba'i rtsa bar 'gyur ba'i bag chags dag /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i las rlung 'gags| |mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i yon tan rdzogs/ /chos rje= stong nyid snying rje dbyer med lam la bsgoms/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rgya mtsho che las rgal// don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i sa la bzhugs/ /chos rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ded dpon gyis gnang ba'i/ /zab lam rin chen mchog 'di sdig grogs dang*/ /chom rkun rtsa lag rnams kyis ma phrogs par| |rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /srid zh-i'i rgya mtsho che las sgral phyir du| |stong nyid snying rje dbyer med rnal 'byor che/ /rtag tu brtsaun pas sgrub par= rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba kun spang ste/ /yid ches gsum dang ldan pa'i zab mo'i lam/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bsgom par = lus dang gnyen bshes kun la ltos med par/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa kun spangs te/ /dkon mchog bla ma'i skor la mi 'bag par| |rtag tu zab lam bsgom par= zhi sogs dman pa'i dngos grub mi 'dod cing*/ /gzugs sogs rtag pa'i bsgom pa kun spangs ste/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /'od gsal phyag chen bsgom par= 'gyur ba'i bde ba don du mi gnyer bar/ /las dang ye shes phyag rgya las grol ba'i// phyag rgya chen mo las byung mi 'gyur bde/ /thob nas rtag tu bsgom par= de nas gsol 'debs snga ma'i/ rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i yul rnams la/

/zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang*/ shes rab rtogs dang sogs tshigs bcad bzhi dang*/ phyogs 'dzin kun dang bral ba'i don rtogs nas/ /bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i lam sgom zhing*/ /thabs mkhas snying rjes 'gro kun smin byas te// myur du sku bzhi thob par= rnam pa kun ldan 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus/ /'gro kun skad du dam pa'i chos ston cing*/ /yod med rtag chad rten 'brel mtha' gnyis spangs| |mi 'gyur bde ba mchog tu mthar phyin shog /ces pa 'di yang snga ma dang mdzad pa po dang dus tshes gcig nyid do// // dge'o// gzhan yang*/ kho bos snga mo nas sbyar ba'i kun la grags pa ni/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ dbang phyug brgyad ldan rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug chos rgyal sum cu gnyis/ /'jam dbyangs sprul sogs 'phags yul mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgra bsgyur chos rab la sogs rwa pa'i tshogs/ /sang dkar bsgom pa la sogs 'bro yi brgyud| |gyi jo rtsa mi la sogs brgyud pa gzhan/ /bod yul mkhas sgrub rnams la= brgyud pa kun 'dus bu ston chos kyi rje/ /bla ma dam pa lo chen sems dpa' che/ chos kyi dpal dang 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud mtshungs med rnams la = 'di bla ma dam pa'i rjes la/ rgyal ba gnyis pa skyabs mchog chos kyi rje/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas seṅge'i mtshan can dang*/ /rgyal sras mtshungs med sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas dpe med 'tsho dang dpal 'dzin zhabs/ /'od byed lha dang chos 'byung nyi ma dpal/ /rin chen 'tsho dang bi bhu ti la sogs// nyer brgyud bar ma'i tshogs la= sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan sha ba ri/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug paṇa chen bi bhū ti/ /zab lam ston mdzad gsum la= nyams rtogs mthar phyin grub chen ko brag pa/

/sgrub tshugs mthar phyin rje btsun gzhon nu dpal/ /gnas lnga mthar son thar lo nyi ma'i zhabs/ /zab lam spel mdzad gsum la= rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston chos gyi rje/ /rgyal sras thu bo 'jam dbyangs chos gyi dpal/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rin chen bsod nams 'phel/ /zab lam gsal mdzad gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi mchog gyur pa/ /rdo rje bzhi yi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos 'jam dbyangs chos gyi rje/ /zab lam rgyas mdzad zhabs la= bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /snying nas gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /gsung rab mthar thug dus 'khor bshad sgrub kyi/ /bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyal par byin gyis rlobs/ /dbang bdun lam mchog sa bdun spang rtogs sgrub/ /sngags gyi tshogs lam chung du rtogs sgom lam/ /rdzogs rim smin byed sgo gsum ye shes sbyong*/ /bsnyen sgrub bzhi ldan bskyed rim mthar phyin shog /bum dbang lam mchog sa brgyad spangs rtogs sgrub/ /tshogs lam 'bring mchog dbang mngon stong gzugs 'dzin// bzung 'dzin 'brel gcod dag pa'i mngon shes sgrub/ /bsnyen pa'i yan lag sor bsam mthar phyin shog /gsang dbang lam mchog dgu pa'i spangs rtogs sgrub| |sbyor lam thog ma y-id mngon rlung sems 'dzin/ /nyi zla'i rgyu 'joms g.yo med thig le sgrub/ /nyer sgrub yan lag srog 'dzin mthar phyin shog/ gsum pa'i lam mchog bcu pa'i spangs rtogs sgrub/ /sbyor lam tha ma rang rig 'dod lha 'dzin/ /lte bar 'od kyi stong gzugs phyag chen sgrub/ /sgrub pa'i yan lag rjes dran mthar phyin shog /bzhi pa'i lam mchog sangs rgyas spangs rtogs sgrub| |'phags pa'i slob lam myur du bde ba che/ /ye shes sku sgrub bem chos mtha' dag 'joms/ /sgrub chen yan lag ting 'dzin mthar phyin shog /rnam kun mchog ldan 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/

/rang rang skad kyis chos ston gzhom med gsung*/ /stong gzugs ky-is 'khyud bde chen mthar thug thugs/ /rdo rje bzhi ldan sku bzhi myur 'grub shog /ces dang*/ bstod chen 'jug gi mdor na rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par du/ zhes sogs sprau na sbyor/ kun la ma grags pa'i rgyas pa ni/ na mo gu ru we/ drin can rtsa ba yi bla ma/ /bka' drin 'khor med kyi chos rje| |mnyam med 'gro ba yi mgon po/ /dpag yas yon tan gyi mnga' bdag/ skyabs gnas thams cad kyi gtso bo/ /dge legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ /dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ /yon tan thams cad gyi gter mdzod/ /sku gsum dbyer med kyi rgyal ba/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo/ theg gsum dam chos kyi 'byung gnas/ /srid gsum sems can gyi 'dren pa/ /dug gsum nad sel gyi sman pa/ /dmus long lam ston gyi sa mkhan/ /ma rig mun sel gyi nyi ma/ /nyon mongs gdung sel gyi zla ba/ /gsol ba snying dkyil nas 'debs so| |thugs rjes 'bral med du bzung shig /byin brlabs char ltar du 'bebs shig /dngos grub bde blag du stsol zhig /bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa la/ /ma bslabs rtsa ba tul bar gsungs lags kyang*/ /tshig don cung zad shes ba'i nga rgyal gyis/ /'jug ldog yal bar dor ba'i snying khams can| |bla mas gnang ba'i tshul khrims yid bzhin nor/ /nyes ltung rkun mas mkhyen ba ma tshor ro/ /tshul khrims gces par 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtag tu dran shes bsten par byin gyis rlobs/ /bstan pa'i gzhung shing sgra dang tshad ma la/ / ma slob tshig don 'khrul par mthong bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi kha zla med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /gang shes brjed du 'jug pa'i snying rul po/ /tshig don dag byed shes rab ral gri de/ /rnam g.yeng bzhi mdor bor ba ma tshor ro/ /rtag tu thos bsam nus par= mi brjed gzungs dang ldan par= bstan pa'i snying po bden gnyis mngon pa'i chos/

/ma bslabs lta bsgom 'khrul par gsungs lags kyang*| |gang shes nyams su len 'dod nges 'byung gis/ ji snyed ji lta rmongs pa'i snyoms las mkhan/ /thabs shes lta spyod yid bzhin nor bu de/ /chog shes rkun mas khyer ba ma tshor ro/ /bden gnyis gnas lugs rtogs par= byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs par= bstan pa'i rtse mo rdo rje theg pa la/ /ma bslabs sangs rgyas thob bar mi srid kyang*/ /phyir ltas tshig gi go rgya gcod gcod nas/ /gsang sngags zhor la btong pa'i mtshan nyid pa/ /rdo rje 'chang gi zab lam bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /phyir ltas sa la bor ba ma tshor ro/ /bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol ba= tha mal snang zhen bsgyur bar = bstan pa'i yang rtsai rnal 'byor bla med la/ /ma bslabs thabs shes rdzogs pa mi srid kyang*/ /lag len phyag rgya'i lag khrid byed byed nas/ /rim gnyis yal bar dor ba'i lag len pa// sgyu lus 'od gsal bden gnyis nyi zla'i 'od/ /lag len sprin gyis sgribs pa ma tshor ro/ /lus phra sku ru ldang bar = sems phra thugs su 'char bar = bstan pa'i mthar thug dus 'khor rnal 'byor la/ /ma sbyangs zung 'jug rdzogs pa mi srid kyang*/ /gsang dbang gsum pa'i lam gyis chog shes nas/ /dus 'khor logs su 'jog pa'i bla med pa/ /bde chen stong gzugs dpag bsam 'bras bu'i mchog /mchog 'dzin ba mos khyer ba ma tshor ro/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom par= bzhi pa'i lam 'bras rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sgo gsum ye shes sbyong bar = stong gzugs mtshan ma rdzogs par= dag pa'i mngon shes 'char bar= nyi zla dbu mar sdom par= 'khor lor thig le 'dod ltar 'char bar= mi 'gyur bde chen rdzogs par = bem chos kun dang bral bar = yan lag bcu gnyis 'gag par= bden don bcu gnyis rdzogs par= de nyid bcu drug rig par= snying rje bcu drug rgyas par= dga' bzhi myur du rdzogs par= gnas skabs bzhi dang bral bar=

sku bzhi myur du 'grub bar= rdo rje bzhi po myur du mthar phyin shog /o āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+shaṃḥ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa b+tā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa'i ngang las/ ka sde dang sa dang po'i rang zhin nang gi skra dang ba spu nam mkha'i khor yug dang chos kyi dbyings| tsa sde dang sa gnyis pa'i rang bzhin sha dang lpags pa rlung gi khor yug dang shar lus 'phags po/ ṭa ste dang sa gsum pa'i rang bzhin khrag dang dmar cha me'i khor yug dang lho 'dzam bu'i gling*/ pa sde dang sa bzhi pa'i rang bzhin rngul dang dri chu'i 'khor yug dang byang sgra mi snyan/ ta sde dang sa lnga pa'i rang bzhin rkang dang rus pa sa'i 'khor yug dang nub ba glang spyod/ sa sde dang sa drug pa'i rang bzhin rtsa dang rlung bcu ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang ye shes/ la sde dang sa bdun pa'i rang bzhin dung can ma dang dus me ye shes rdo rje/ a sde dang sa brgyad pa'i rang bzhin dbu ma dang gnyid 'thug sgra gcan dang thugs rdo rje/ l̥ sde dang sa dgu pa'i rang bzhin ro ma dang rmi lam nyi ma dang gsung rdo rje/ āḥhaṃ dang sa bcu pa'i rang bzhin rkyang ma dang sad pa zla ba dang sku rdo rje/ gzhan yang rnam bcu dbang ldan/ stong chen yig lnga/ thig le yig drug gis rgyas btab pa'i phyi nang gzhan gsum/ srid zhi 'khor 'das/ lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge rtsas bsdus pa'i dpal 'byor thams cad sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi'i dbang phyug dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas khyab bdag dus kyi 'khor lo dang tha mi dad par gyur pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi gnas lugs mngon du gyur pa drang don nges don gyi rtogs pa myur du rgyud la skye zhing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlab du gsol/

srid zhi'i phun tshogs kun tshang rdo rje'i lus/ /phyi dang gzhan la sbyar ba mchod pa'i sprin/ /rang la legs par gnas pa 'di 'bul bas/ /sgrib bral mthar thug rdo rje'i sku thob shog ces sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgyas par dbul te/ dngos grub gnyis kyi dpal 'byor zad mi shes pa myur du bsgrub bar bya'o| |dge legs rtsa ba spyi dgos bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs tshul legs par bkod pa 'dis/ /dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba gting tshugs nas/ /phun tshogs sku bzhi'i dpag bsam rgyas rgyur cig /ces pa yang rang gi zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro'i yan lag tu dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// // dge legs 'phel/ gcig zhus// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi gsol 'debs byin brlabs rol mtsho/ -PAGE 280--PAGE 281-- PAGE 278-
